title: Fast and compact temporal convolutional network for non-resonant background removal in broadband CARS

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Fast and compact temporal convolutional network for non-resonant background removal in broadband CARS》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Broadband coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (BCARS) microscopy enables the acquisition of full Raman spectra (400-3200 cm-1) within milliseconds, offering substantial potential for rapid, label-free chemical imaging.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Fast and compact temporal convolutional network for non-resonant background removal in broadband CARS》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Although existing deep learning approaches have achieved effective NRB suppression with a maximum coefficient of determination of 0.99, they generally suffer from a trade-off between prediction accuracy and inference efficiency.

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】Ablation studies verify that the dilated convolution architecture effectively balances structural simplicity, prediction accuracy, and computational efficiency, making it highly suitable for high-speed BCARS spectral detection and imaging tasks.

evidence.text: Although existing deep learning approaches have achieved effective NRB suppression with a maximum coefficient of determination of 0.99, they generally suffer from a trade-off between prediction accuracy and inference efficiency.

Ablation studies verify that the dilated convolution architecture effectively balances structural simplicity, prediction accuracy, and computational efficiency, making it highly suitable for high-speed BCARS spectral detection and imaging tasks.
